title: Jacob Marries Leah and Rachel

questions.question: Who did Jacob meet at the well?
questions.explanation: Genesis 29:10: Jacob saw Rachel, Laban's daughter, at the well.

questions.question: How many years did Jacob agree to work for Rachel?
questions.explanation: Genesis 29:18: Jacob agreed to serve seven years for Rachel.

questions.question: Who did Laban give Jacob on his wedding night instead of Rachel?
questions.explanation: Genesis 29:23: Laban gave Leah to Jacob instead of Rachel.

questions.question: Who was Jacob's first son?
questions.explanation: Genesis 29:32: Leah bore Reuben, Jacob's firstborn.

questions.question: Was Jacob deceived by Laban?
questions.explanation: Genesis 29:25: Jacob discovered the deception in the morning.

questions.question: What did the seven years seem like to Jacob?
options: Like a few days because of his love
questions.correctAnswer: Like a few days because of his love
questions.explanation: Genesis 29:20: "they seemed to him but a few days because of the love he had for her."

questions.question: How long did Jacob have to wait after marrying Leah to marry Rachel?
questions.explanation: Genesis 29:27-28: Jacob completed Leah's week and then married Rachel.

questions.question: Which wife did Jacob love more?
questions.explanation: Genesis 29:30: "he loved Rachel more than Leah."

questions.question: How many sons did Leah bear Jacob in this chapter?
questions.explanation: Genesis 29:32-35: Leah bore Reuben, Simeon, Levi, and Judah.

questions.question: Why did God open Leah's womb?
questions.explanation: Genesis 29:31: "the LORD saw that Leah was hated, he opened her womb."

questions.question: What reason did Laban give for giving Leah first?
options: It is not so done in our country to give the younger before the firstborn
questions.correctAnswer: It is not so done in our country to give the younger before the firstborn
questions.explanation: Genesis 29:26: Custom dictated the older daughter should marry first.

questions.question: What was Leah's maidservant's name?
questions.explanation: Genesis 29:24: Laban gave Zilpah as Leah's maidservant.

questions.question: What was Rachel's maidservant's name?
questions.explanation: Genesis 29:29: Laban gave Bilhah as Rachel's maidservant.

questions.question: What did Leah say when she bore Judah?
options: "This time I will praise the LORD"
questions.correctAnswer: "This time I will praise the LORD"
questions.explanation: Genesis 29:35: "This time I will praise the LORD."

questions.question: What does Reuben mean?
options: "See, a son" / "The LORD has looked on my affliction"
questions.correctAnswer: "See, a son" / "The LORD has looked on my affliction"
questions.explanation: Genesis 29:32: The name relates to God seeing Leah's affliction.

key_verse_text: So Jacob served seven years for Rachel, and they seemed to him but a few days because of the love he had for her.
